title: Foundation Medicine Adult Cancer Clinical Dataset (FM-AD), meningioma subset
institution: Foundation Medicine, Inc. (data source) / National Cancer Institute Genomic Data Commons (data coordination)
needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-11), from a discovery-log LEAD reporting 49 meningioma cases (disease_type 'Meningiomas') out of 18,004 total cases in the FM-AD project, with 149 files. Independently re-verified live via the GDC REST API (not transcribed from the log): filtering cases by project.project_id=FM-AD and disease_type=Meningiomas returns exactly 49 cases, all with diagnoses.primary_diagnosis literally 'Meningioma, NOS' (confirmed via a separate cases query with diagnoses.primary_diagnosis field); the FM-AD project's own summary confirms case_count=18,004 total across the whole program. Filtering files by cases.project.project_id=FM-AD AND cases.disease_type=Meningiomas and faceting by data_category/data_type/experimental_strategy/access confirms exactly 149 total files: 49 Raw Simple Somatic Mutation + 49 Aggregated Somatic Mutation + 49 Annotated Somatic Mutation (all experimental_strategy='Targeted Sequencing', all access='controlled'), plus 1 open-access Biospecimen Supplement and 1 open-access Clinical Supplement. This independently reproduces the discovery log's figures exactly. FM-AD is Foundation Medicine's commercial clinical targeted-panel-sequencing dataset (FoundationOne-style assay), i.e. derived variant-call data from a targeted gene panel, not raw WES/WGS/RNA-seq; modality set to targeted_panel_seq accordingly. All 49 cases queried for diagnoses.tumor_grade returned 'Not Reported' uniformly, and demographic.gender/diagnoses.age_at_diagnosis were not populated (null) for any case via the public API, consistent with this de-identified commercial clinical dataset exposing limited demographic detail at the open API level; sex_distribution/age_distribution/grade_breakdown left 'Not reported'/null accordingly, not fabricated. No corresponding_author or single-PI exists (FM-AD is a data-sharing partnership/consortium resource, not a single-paper study), same pattern as the already-existing gdc-ccdi-mci-pediatric-meningioma.json record in this inventory; no dedicated publication describing this specific meningioma subset was found. Per docs/scope.md, only public GDC case/file summary-level metadata was used (counts, data categories, experimental strategy, access flags); the controlled-access targeted-sequencing variant calls themselves, and the 2 open-access supplement files, were never downloaded or opened in this pass, only their existence/count confirmed via the API. processed_data_available set to true reflecting the aggregated/annotated somatic mutation call files (these are themselves processed/derived data products, distinct from any raw sequencing reads which FM-AD does not appear to expose at all, consistent with a commercial panel product); raw_data_available set to false since no raw sequencing reads (FASTQ/BAM) were found among the 149 files, only variant-call-level products. tags.large_cohort left false pending the centralized post-hoc recomputation across the whole inventory noted in docs/schema.md (targeted_panel_seq is one of the modalities not yet computed, too few records).
